title: Many short reviews beat one long session
summary: Split study into several two-to-five minute reviews and protect the last one before sleep.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Memory prefers repetitions spread across separate moments, not one long sit. Ten minutes split into four visits through the same small set of words will beat one forty-minute block, because each visit starts from a partly forgotten state, and recovering a word is what strengthens it. Use the gaps you already have: waiting for a kettle, standing in a queue, sitting on a bus. Add a rule for anything you fail twice in a week, and move it into the set you review last thing at night.
